resolveId() returns only the first hit across 6 buckets with no disambiguation UI, and its name search covers riders and drivers only - trips, subscriptions, payments and complaints are findable only by exact id
The sidebar footer reads 'Owner - settings v', advertising a dropdown menu that does not exist; the click goes straight to my-account

modules.name: Global: UI Systems
modules.purpose: Seven cross-cutting systems every business module depends on: one reusable modal overlay driven by direct innerHTML assignment (99 opening sites, no openModal() function), a three-registry confirmation-gate layer built on confirmAction()/guardAction() covering 88 actions, a toast stack that mirrors into the notification centre (349 call sites), 26 CSS design tokens, a 219-name class vocabulary, two render-blocking Leaflet CDN dependencies, and the init/lifecycle machinery (a 100ms one-shot render pass, a 1Hz tick engine, a 16-step boot IIFE). There is no framework, no build step and no persistence layer.

findings.summary: closeModal() calls reqClearLocks(), which wipes claimedBy/claimedAt on EVERY ride and subscription request whenever ANY modal closes - including modals unrelated to request claiming
All 99 modals, all 349 toasts and every table render interpolate DB values into HTML strings with no escaping; toast() strips tags only for the title attribute, not the visible message
guardAction swallows builder exceptions (try{spec=builder(...)}catch(e){spec=null}) and a null spec means the action runs UNGUARDED - a bug in a gate builder silently removes the gate
window.__skipGuards is a public global; anything - a pasted console line or injected HTML - can set it true and disable all 88 confirmation gates
guardAction monkey-patches window[name] at load, so any code holding a reference captured before installation bypasses the gate; install order is spread over 5,000 lines
__guardToken lets the original through once during onConfirm; a nested call to the same action inside that window also passes ungated
__confirmPending is a single global - opening a second confirmAction() while one is pending silently overwrites the first
No ESC handling anywhere - zero Escape/keyCode-27 handlers exist; a modal is dismissable only by mouse, and there is no role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap or focus restore
Four modal-scoped setIntervals (1000ms and 250ms) are cleared only by their own bespoke buttons; dismissing by clicking the overlay leaves the timer running against a removed DOM subtree
confirmModal() is a legacy stub that fires a native alert() and is still wired as the confirm button of openRenewModal
Add-side actions are confirm-gated while their remove-side counterparts are not (gateways, operational limits), and flagging an account is modal-gated while unflagging is a single click
GATE_SPECS.openLowRatingTicket is null and GATE_SWEEP.assignBackup/.autoHandoff are declared then deleted two lines later, making the registry counts misleading
The gate-sweep comment names audit_mut.js as the re-runnable deliverable that enforces the no-ungated-action invariant, but no such file exists in the repository

Zero persistence - no localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookies, fetch/XHR or service worker anywhere in 21,857 lines. Every gate that promises 'Recorded in the activity log under your name' describes state destroyed on refresh

TOAST_MAX=1 synchronously removes older toasts, so when several alerts fire in the same tick all but the last are never seen; the 19 calls passing notify=false have no notification-centre mirror to fall back on

No element with id=map-leaflet exists in the markup, so initLeafletMap(), updateLiveMarkers(), renderLiveMap(), TRIP_COORDS, TRIP_COLORS, carIcon() and the flyToBounds selection code - roughly 120 lines - are unreachable, and updateLiveMarkers is still called every second by the tick engine
Two render-blocking unpkg.com assets (~150KB) load on every page view with no SRI, no crossorigin, no defer and no local fallback, to serve one optional 200x110px city-picker thumbnail
The 100ms one-shot init pass runs 45 sequential calls with no try/catch; one throw kills everything after it, including startTickEngine() at position 42
The 1Hz tick engine is never cleared and has no visibility or idle pause; it runs Math.random() simulations, re-renders visible pages and mutates DB forever, including in a backgrounded tab
A MutationObserver watches the entire document.body subtree purely to auto-size select elements, so every table render, toast and modal write re-triggers it (debounced to 60ms)

The boot IIFE must remain the last thing in the script (documented in capitals at L21802) but nothing enforces it; a module appended after it would have its var initialisers unassigned when the seeds run

The panel cannot run under any reasonable CSP: it needs unsafe-inline for hundreds of onclick attributes, unsafe-eval for new Function(onChangeExpr) at L5411, plus unpkg.com and tile.openstreetmap.org allowances

Roughly 40 stylesheet colours are untokenised (including two different blues for live affordances), --sb-bg and --bg hold the same value #EEF0F3, and .map-stat/.ms-item/.ms-lbl/.ms-val are each defined twice with conflicting rules
installActionGates() ASSIGNS window.__gateCount while the other two installers ADD to it; the arithmetic only works because installActionGates runs first, and any reordering silently resets the count

modules.name: Global: Identity, Permissions & Audit
modules.purpose: Three interlocking global systems answering who is acting, what they may do, and what they did. Identity is a single module-scope variable CURRENT_USER_ID backed by DB.teamUsers (5 operators). Permissions are two layers: a flat 13-key broad vocabulary (PERMISSION_LABELS) enforced by can()/requirePerm() at 131 sites, and a 52-key granular page-action layer (PAGE_PERMISSIONS, 22 pages) enforced by canPage()/requirePagePerm() at 20 sites. Audit is logAction(), which unshifts to DB.auditLog and is rendered by the Activity Log page (p-audit-log, L2051) and a 4-row Settings preview.

kpis.name: Broad permission guard coverage
kpis.formula: 131 requirePerm('<key>') call sites covering 12 of 13 keys; view_profiles has ZERO. Distribution: manage_settings 39, manage_subscriptions 23, manage_plans 16, approve_drivers 14, live_ops 13, contact_users 8, process_payouts 6, manage_team 5, manage_tickets 4, view_finance 1, release_escrow 1, apply_deductions 1

kpis.name: Granular permission guard coverage
kpis.formula: 20 requirePagePerm() call sites covering 15 distinct page.perm pairs out of 52 declared keys (71% never enforced); all 22 'view' keys are enforced nowhere

kpis.name: canPage() call sites
kpis.formula: exactly 2 - its own declaration and requirePagePerm; no navigation, sidebar or go() path consults it

kpis.name: Audit action-key label coverage
kpis.formula: 161 distinct actionKey literals across 220 real logAction() call sites; ACTION_LABELS has 26 keys, so 135 (84%) are unlabelled and absent from the Activity Log action-type filter

kpis.formula: if (DB.auditLog.length > 500) DB.auditLog.length = 500 - oldest entries silently dropped

findings.summary: commitUserSwitch() is completely ungated - any operator can click the top-bar avatar and become the Owner, acquiring all 13 permissions. Total RBAC bypass
recordRefund() issues a refund and a VAT-reversing credit note with NO requirePerm and NO logAction - money leaves the platform with no permission check and no audit trail

commitSettlement() cancels a subscription and books the rider refund plus driver payout with no permission check; only the modal opener openSettlement checks manage_subscriptions, violating the file's own stated rule that gates go on the commit function
commitCashRepayment() writes off a driver's outstanding cash debt with no permission check; only the opener recordCashRepayment checks process_payouts and wallets.cash_repayment

No export function is permission-gated. All 13 entry points, including exportAuditLog and exportPayments, run for any operator; exportRequestsSnapshot additionally calls no logAction, so that exfiltration leaves no trace at all

Impersonation misattributes every action. guardAction('impersonate') promises actions are recorded against your own name, but logAction reads the already-reassigned CURRENT_USER_ID, so actions during impersonation are attributed to the impersonated user. The stated safety property is inverted

executePayout() unconditionally writes a 'payment confirmed' notification to the driver and swaps the modal to 'Payment sent' after calling payDriver(), even when payDriver's requirePerm('process_payouts') denied the payout
commitWalletAdjust credits and debits rider wallets under contact_users - a communications permission held by Support - instead of view_finance or process_payouts

19 of the 41 page shells have no PAGE_PERMISSIONS entry, including Fraud & Risk, Rider Wallets, Corporate Account detail, 360 Profile, Applicant Detail (KYC) and Contact Drivers - directly violating the file's own standing rule at L10556
view_profiles is granted to all 5 seeded users and enforced at zero requirePerm sites; p-profile is also absent from PAGE_PERMISSIONS, so PII access is entirely ungoverned

37 of the 52 declared granular permission keys (71%) are never enforced. All 22 'view' keys are enforced nowhere - canPage() has exactly two call sites and no navigation, sidebar or go() path consults it

changeMaPassword() never verifies the current password and never stores the new one, yet clears the inputs, toasts 'Password updated' and writes a change_password audit entry asserting a credential change that did not occur

135 of 161 audit action keys (84%) have no ACTION_LABELS entry and are therefore unreachable from the Activity Log action-type filter, including impersonation_started, impersonation_ended, toggle_page_permission, change_password, toggle_2fa, erasure_executed and config_updated (40 call sites)

The two identity mechanisms do not cooperate: commitUserSwitch never sets window.__realUserId and never calls renderImpersonationBar, so an avatar switch leaves no amber banner and no way back except a page reload
nm2() resolves only DB.riders and DB.drivers, so both impersonation audit summaries print the raw USR- id instead of a name
renderSidebarPerms is called at L21075 and L21086 behind typeof guards but is not defined anywhere in the file - the sidebar permission refresh impersonation was meant to trigger never runs

Read-modals for privileged screens open with no check - viewUserPermissions, editTeamUser and openInviteModal each let any operator fill in the form and only discover they lack manage_team on the final click
The two self-lockout guards (blocking a user from revoking their own manage_team) toast only and write no audit entry, unlike every other denial
commitInvite pushes a user with no phone, photo, twoFA or pagePerms field, so every newly invited operator immediately shows the red '2FA off' badge in the team table

renderRoleMatrix and renderPagePermMatrix derive the role list from live DB.teamUsers data, so if the last holder of a role is edited away that role's column silently vanishes from both matrices and its permission set becomes unreachable

The audit log is capped at 500 entries and silently drops the oldest with no warning, no archive and no UI indication; config_updated alone fires from 40 call sites, so a settings-heavy session can push genuine security events off the end

Audit ids are generated as 'AUD-'+(length+1), so once the array is pinned at 500 every subsequent entry is AUD-0501; the free-text search includes e.id, so searching an id after truncation returns an unbounded set

manage_settings is a single point of failure - 39 of 131 broad guards require it and only USR-1 holds it, so cities, gateways, dispatch, security, branding, legal, retention, SLA, on-call and GDPR erasure are all one-operator capabilities
removePlanFeature and pfDrop mutate PLAN_FEATURES with no confirmation and no logAction; the change becomes visible only when the gated savePlan runs later
openUserSwitchGuardless() is an empty function body with zero call sites - a name implying a deliberate guard bypass that was never wired up
toggleMa2FA writes u.twoFA and toasts but never calls renderMaSecurity(), so the Enabled/Disabled label disagrees with the toggle for the rest of the page visit
auditDiffHTML iterates Object.keys(after) only, so a field present in before and absent from after - i.e. something deleted - produces no diff line
Seeded audit rows carry full date-and-time strings while logAction produces time-only via toLocaleTimeString with no locale, so a log spanning both is unsortable and ambiguous after midnight
PERMISSION_DESC.manage_team is assigned in the object literal at L3255 and then overwritten by a bare statement at L10520; only the second string ever renders
requirePerm logs the bare permission key as entityId while requirePagePerm logs a dotted page.perm pair, both under entityType 'permission' - two incompatible key spaces under one type

resolveId does not search DB.teamUsers, so every entityType 'team_user' audit row renders its USR- id as inert monospace text; the seeded process_all_payouts row also has entityId '' and renders a blank cell

Every granted state is unauthenticated in-memory data - u.permissions is a plain array and can() is a client-side indexOf, yet the My Account copy claims permissions are 'enforced everywhere in this panel'

modules.name: Predictive Signals
modules.purpose: A single early-warning layer flagging problems before they land across five independent domains: subscription churn, driver availability, renewal payment failure, repeat incident patterns and structural zone shortages. Each domain uses the same recipe — historical pattern plus a current early signal plus a threshold that fires before the failure.

kpis.name: Open signals (all types)
kpis.thresholds: colour var(--amber) unconditional; progress bar HARDCODED width:55%

kpis.name: Predicted churn (subs)
kpis.formula: count of non-cancelled subscriptions where subHealthScore(s).score < 50
kpis.thresholds: colour var(--red) unconditional; bar min(100, redSubs*20)%

kpis.name: At-risk drivers
kpis.formula: count over all DB.drivers where driverRiskScore(d).score < 80
kpis.thresholds: colour var(--red) unconditional; bar min(100, atRiskDrivers*20)%

kpis.name: Revenue at risk
kpis.formula: sum of subEconomics(s).remaining over non-cancelled subs with subHealthScore(s).score < 50, .toFixed(0)
kpis.thresholds: colour var(--amber) unconditional; progress bar HARDCODED width:40%

kpis.name: Sidebar badge #sbb-predictive
kpis.formula: redSubs + atRiskDrivers — deliberately omits payment-risk, incident and zone signals so it never matches KPI 1

kpis.name: Subscription health score
kpis.formula: 100 minus weighted deductions (25 pace / 15 no-backup / 25 driver in trouble / 10 rider complaints / 20 payment risk / 30 driver suspended), floored at 0
kpis.thresholds: >=80 Healthy green, 50-79 At risk amber, <50 Predicted churn red

kpis.name: Driver availability risk score
kpis.formula: 100 minus deductions (40 expired doc / 20 doc expiring within 14d / 30 suspended / 15 per open issue, unbounded / 10 overloaded with no relief / 30 cash-collection suspended / 20 repeat cash under-reporting), floored at 0

kpis.name: Zone failure rate
kpis.thresholds: row qualifies at demand/supply>=3 AND failRate>=50

modules.name: Fraud & Risk
modules.purpose: Surfaces fraud and abuse signals computed from data that actually exists on account records — shared last-known IP, the referral log and trip history — plus a pre-migration identity-collision audit over rider and driver email/phone. GPS-anomaly detection is deliberately not simulated and the page says so instead of faking a number.

kpis.name: Shared device/IP groups
kpis.formula: sharedGroups.length = number of distinct lastIp values shared by more than one rider

kpis.name: Referral self-abuse flags
kpis.formula: refFlags.length = DB.referralLog entries where referrer and referee share lastIp OR device; sub-label denominator is DB.referralLog.length

kpis.name: Unusual pairings
kpis.formula: pairFlags.length = driver-rider pairs with >= 3 shared trips

kpis.name: Sidebar badge #sbb-fraud
kpis.formula: totalFlags = sharedGroups.length + refFlags.length + pairFlags.length, written as totalFlags||'' so it renders blank rather than 0

kpis.name: Identity collisions / cross-role collisions
kpis.formula: all.length and cross = collisions whose records span more than one role; inline bold text only, in no KPI and not in totalFlags
kpis.thresholds: cross numeral var(--red) when >0 else var(--ink)

findings.summary: commitSuspendAccount has no confirmation gate — one click of Suspend cuts a driver from dispatch, writes state, logs and navigates; it appears in neither GATE_SPECS nor GATE_SWEEP
The pairing signal consumes reconstructed history whose driver is chosen by seeded RNG, so a '3+ shared trips' flag can be a generation artefact rather than an observed pattern

No PAGE_PERMISSIONS entry for 'fraud' — canPage('fraud',…) is always false, the Settings permission matrix offers no row, and the only enforcement is the broad approve_drivers check inside commitSuspendAccount
The 'Shared device / IP' card never reads r.device — it groups on lastIp alone despite the title, caption and detected-reason strings all saying device/IP
In a referral self-abuse flag only the referee gets a Suspend button; there is no control to act on the referrer, void the referral or claw back either bonus
device is a coarse model-plus-OS string, not a fingerprint — two unrelated riders on the same phone model and OS version satisfy a.device===b.device and would be flagged
The pairing rule is an absolute count of >= 3 with no baseline or normalisation, despite a caption promising 'far more than random chance would suggest'
Suspending navigates away to the profile and never re-renders the fraud page, so working through a list of flagged accounts requires re-entering the page after every action
Identity collisions reach neither the KPI row nor the sidebar badge — totalFlags sums only the three renderFraudPage signals
DB.pendingDrivers and DB.teamUsers are outside the collision audit, so a pending applicant reusing an existing driver's phone is not detected
renderIdentityCollisions() is not called at boot (only renderFraudPage is), so #identity-collisions is empty markup until the page is first visited
No reinstate control on this page — reinstateAccount() is wired only into the 360 profile
subs map has no 'fraud' key so the toolbar subtitle renders empty on this page
No go(...) call originates from the page body, so there is no path from a flag to Safety, Support or Audit where a fraud case would be worked

The pairing block re-implements the shared-trip count inline instead of calling priorTripsWithRider(), which computes exactly that statistic; contrary to the doc's suspicion, that helper and the neighbouring complaint helpers are NOT dead — they are used by the Subscriptions and dispatch modules
The GPS anomaly card is a deliberate non-implementation — static prose with no id, no render function and no data source
Doc header states HTML lines 649-673; the page div actually starts at 650

findings.summary: WORK_ROUTING routes 11 of 12 queues to the role string 'Operations', which is not a member of TEAM_ROLES - an Ops Manager sees a permanently empty inbox with role routing on
Tab counts are computed from the unfiltered inboxItems() while rows come from inboxFiltered(), so a tab can read 'Everything . 9' and render zero rows
The four KPI tiles ignore both the tab and the role checkbox - they always describe the whole system regardless of what the list shows
'Overdue right now' counts the hardcoded dueMs=-1 sentinels, so dispatch, leg-uncovered and critical incident items permanently inflate the KPI and the sidebar badge
updateInboxBadge uses a JS logical-or rather than addition, so as soon as one item is breached the badge stops reporting unclaimed work entirely and silently changes meaning
#my-work-chip reads 'N mine' and is maintained by the inbox module but navigates to the Support Center, not the inbox
whoHolds() auto-releases stale claims and writes a claim_expired audit row as a read side effect, so merely rendering the inbox mutates DB.ownership and DB.audit
inboxOpen silently claims an item on open, so merely looking at a case takes it out of the unassigned pool; there is no view-only affordance
inboxOpen evaluates the item's action string through new Function() with no escaping applied when the strings are assembled from record ids
No inbox action is permission-gated - claim, release, take over and close-case all mutate DB.ownership without requirePerm()
DB.ownershipConfig.warnTakeover is declared but never read anywhere in the file
completeItem() marks a claim 'done' but renderInbox never filters on that state, so the function has no effect on what the inbox shows
workChip() combines the case chip and owner chip but renderInbox composes the two separately, leaving workChip unused
The module header comment claims 'Thirteen queues' while QUEUE_LABEL defines twelve, and the KPI sub-line renders 12
The 'all' tab empty state names the operator's role even when role routing is switched off, where nothing is being routed away

inboxItems() and the dashboard's buildInterventionItems() are two independent builders over overlapping data - ride requests never reach the inbox, lost-and-found / PDPL / coverage never reach the dashboard
DB.ownership and DB.cases are seeded empty and _inboxTab defaults to 'mine', so the page opens on an empty tab for every fresh session
No search box, severity filter, queue-type filter, date range or pagination - the only controls are three tabs and one role checkbox
No data-i18n attribute exists inside #p-inbox and no string produced by the render path passes through LANG_STRINGS - the whole module is English-only
leg and coverage items both key ownership on a subscription id, so leg:SUB-xxxx and coverage:SUB-xxxx are separate unlinked claims for what may be one underlying problem

UNVERIFIED - confirmAction() implementation, legAck() weight assignment and dispatchEligibility()/nearestEligibleDrivers() (which decide the coverage uncovered flag) were not traced

findings.summary: Eleven producers emit the undeclared types 'warn' and 'ok', which are absent from notifIcon and unmatched by notifPriority, so manager approvals, policy violations, low-rating alerts and regulator warnings all degrade to a generic bell icon and the Low tier at the bottom of the page
pushOpsNotification refreshes the dropdown when open but never calls renderAllNotificationsPage, so a user sitting on the full page sees nothing new until they click a chip or re-enter the page
No logAction call exists anywhere in the notification module - dismissing a critical safety alert leaves no trace of who did it or when
markAllRead mutates DB on a single click and is absent from the gateAll permission registry, despite that registry's header comment claiming every DB-mutating onclick was registered
n.title and n.desc are interpolated into innerHTML unescaped, and toast-derived titles already carry HTML markup - a real XSS surface once any of these strings becomes user-supplied
DB.notifications has no size cap and no eviction while tickEngine runs every second and every toast mirrors in; the full page renders every record into one innerHTML assignment

updateBellBadge counts all unread records equally, so the priority triage the module is built around never reaches the badge - a stack of low toast confirmations reads identically to a stack of criticals
Types 'alert' and 'complaint' have no click destination in handleNotifClick; seed records N1 and N6 carry no action closure and are therefore click-dead - they mark read and nothing else happens

The Live Map's setMapFilter uses an unscoped document.querySelectorAll('.map-fchip') and toggles the on class by data-filt, so clicking a map filter chip silently strips the highlight from the Notifications page chips (which carry no data-filt), desynchronising the visible chip from _notifPageFilter
Every runtime record's time is the literal 'Just now' and is never recomputed, so an hour-old notification still reads as new
No dedupe - repeated identical toasts create separate records; only the SLA sweep guards itself via t.slaBreaches
markAllRead has no null guard on getElementById('p-notifications-all') while handleNotifClick does; harmless because the element is static markup but asymmetric
The #nf-cnt-* chip count spans stay empty until the page is first visited - the boot block calls updateBellBadge but never renderAllNotificationsPage
NOTIF_PRIORITY_LABEL is declared but never referenced anywhere in the file (grep returns exactly one hit, its own declaration)
DB.opsConfig.notifications.smsAlerts and .notifyOnDispute are written and restored by the Settings tab but never read by any logic
Types 'renewal', 'approval' and 'complaint' have full icon, priority and routing support but no runtime producer - they exist only as seed records N3, N4 and N6

There is no sidebar nav item for notifications-all; the page is reachable only through the bell dropdown, and because openAllNotifications passes a null element no sidebar item is highlighted when it opens

No persistence of any kind - read flags, runtime records and __notifSeq all reset on reload and the badge returns to 3; read state is global rather than per user; and no data-i18n attribute exists in the bell, panel or page
emailAlerts is used as an on/off gate for an in-panel notification (the low-rating producer), not for email - a misnamed reuse of the Settings flag

UNVERIFIED - the click action argument for the producers at L15887, L16719, L16723, L17293 and L17306 was not read; type and title are grep-verified but the closures span multiple lines. Also unverified: whether markAllRead's absence from gateAll is an intentional exemption
Doc line drift corrected against source: the #p-notifications-all page div closes at L1187, not L1189 (L1188 is blank and L1189 is the next page's section comment)

findings.summary: renderActiveTrips emits pingBorderStyle(t) as literal text: the concatenation fragment sits inside the single-quoted JS string, so the red/amber stale-GPS left border never renders and malformed attribute text leaks into the markup

In Live mode the tick engine calls the dead updateLiveMarkers() instead of drawMap(), so the canvas is never redrawn while Live is selected even though trip progress keeps advancing every second - the map that advertises 'updates every second' is visually frozen

commitLiveReassign and confirmCancelLiveTrip mutate only DB.liveTrips; DB.trips[id] keeps the old driver and the 'In trip' status, so the history table and the Trips page permanently disagree with the live board after either action

The entire Leaflet/OSM layer (L11526-L11635) is unreachable: renderLiveMap and initLeafletMap have no callers, #map-leaflet does not exist in the markup, and updateLiveMarkers/showHistoryRoute bail on their first line because _lmap is null - yet two CDN resources are still loaded on every page view
#live-last-update is permanently empty because its only writer is the dead updateLiveMarkers()
cancelRequest deletes a pending ride request immediately with no confirmation dialog, despite being permission-gated and destructive
Auto-created live trips are pushed with mapTrip null and a random TRP-91xx id absent from MAP_ROUTES, so Track always warns and no canvas dot is drawn for any trip created during the session
commitLiveReassign toasts 'rider notified' and sendRiderChangeNotif toasts 'Rider notified' with no corresponding sendSystemEmail or notification call
updateMapStats runs in Live mode too, so the stats bar shows the history-selected trip (TRP-7741 by default) while the header claims live tracking

setMapFilter uses an unscoped document.querySelectorAll('.map-fchip') and toggles the on class by data-filt, so clicking a map filter chip also strips the highlight from the Notifications and Requests page chips, which carry no data-filt attribute
logDriverCall changes driverStatus (and can mark a driver unavailable with a reason) but writes no logAction audit entry, unlike every other state-changing action on this page
openSendChatModal and commitSendChatMsg are unreachable from this page - the Chat button calls openTripChatView, which opens the profile instead
All 8 seeded DB.trips are dated 25 Jun, so the 'Yesterday - 24 Jun' and '23 Jun' date options always yield the empty state and 'No replayable trips'

renderMapTripsTable and renderMapTripsTableFiltered are near-duplicate implementations that diverge: the filtered variant labels the vehicle fallback 'Eco' where the unfiltered one uses 'Economy', and its replay button label is the bare play glyph
Two conflicting .map-stat / .ms-item CSS declarations exist; the later block at L365-L368 wins and the earlier one at L217-L220 is dead
The status filter chips affect only the table, never the canvas - filtering to Cancelled still leaves the previously selected route drawn
Router ordering quirk: the live branch calls renderMapTripsTable() to fill the tbody and then, 50 ms later, setMapMode('live') overwrites it with the 'Switch to History to browse trips.' placeholder
The live-mode bar hardcodes '3 active trips . updates every second' and is never recomputed from DB.liveTrips

Two external CDN dependencies (leaflet.css and leaflet.js) load on every page view for a layer that never executes, and would fail offline - contradicting the source comment that justifies the canvas renderer as having no external dependency
Zero data-i18n attributes exist anywhere inside p-live; every string on the page is hardcoded English and the only i18n key is the sidebar nav label nav.live

The dispatch and routing models are simulations: 8% random assign failure, a driver acceptance probability derived from rating, a 2% per-tick chance of a fabricated chat message, and MAP_ROUTES geometry in canvas pixel space rather than real coordinates

findings.summary: commitSettlement records a settlement but moves no money - no refund, wallet credit or payout is written
The settlement audit entry hardcodes {status:'Active'} as the before-state regardless of the real prior status
Two driver-commission rates in one module: the table uses the flat 20% while the profile uses the per-plan eyvarPct
The auto-renew toggle mutates DB.subscriptions and writes audit entries with no requirePerm gate
The filter-bar search input has no id and no handler - typing does nothing
The status filter offers 'At risk' but no code path ever assigns that status, so it always yields the empty state
No unfreeze path exists - doFreeze sets status='Frozen' and the modal promises 'until you unfreeze', but nothing resumes
The freeze reason field #frz-reason is never read - not by doFreeze and not by the audit payload
The 'Days left' column header sits over a cell that prints 'Ends {sub.ends}' - no day count is ever computed
Export ignores the active plan/vehicle/status filters and always emits every subscription
The profile trip log sorts by localeCompare over '25 Jun 07:00'-style labels, so it is not chronological
finalizeNewSub contains two identical needsApproval branches; the second is unreachable
buildSubProfile renders a Postponed-trips banner but no function in the file ever writes sub.postponements
subEconomics().driverFull is computed and returned but read nowhere
cancelSubDispatch aborts an in-flight creation silently - no toast, no audit entry, no record that a driver was asked
The dispatch note 'Auto-reassigns after 2:00 if no response' is display-only; no auto-reassign timeout exists
Granular subscriptions.{view,change_driver,settle} permission keys are declared but every call site checks only the legacy manage_subscriptions

All four KPI tiles, the page subtitle and the sidebar badge ship hardcoded demo numbers in markup

findings.summary: cancelledThisMonth is computed on every render and never used; it is also misnamed — there is no month restriction
renderSuccess() writes no audit entry and no DB.payments record, so a completed renewal is invisible to both the activity log and Finance
renderSuccess() refreshes the subscriptions table and readiness but never calls renderRenewalPipeline(), leaving the page the operator launched from stale
A renewal that creates a brand-new subscription skips generateUpcomingTripsForSubscription(), so no readiness trips ever exist for it
sbb-renew uses parseInt(x.ends,10)-25 <= 3 — month-blind, no lower bound, and a 3-day window against the page's 7 — so the sidebar badge routinely disagrees with the page total
KPI counts are computed after the filter is applied, so all three tiles and the page subtitle describe only the filtered subset
autoRenew is absent from every seeded subscription, so 'Manual renewal required' reads 0 and the manual filter is empty until an operator explicitly turns auto-renew off
The renewal page bands health at >=70/>=40 while healthBand() on Predictive Signals bands the same score at >=80/>=50, so identical scores are labelled differently on the two pages
No permission gate exists on page entry, on the ⋯ menu or on the wizard's charge path — only sendRenewalApprovalRequest and commitRetentionAction are gated
GATE_SWEEP.commitRetentionAction warns the action 'May issue credit or change the subscription terms', but the implementation writes nothing to the subscription
pickPlan() relies on the implicit global event, which breaks under strict mode or programmatic invocation
The wizard's VAT line is the literal string 'included' and Total equals Subtotal — no VAT is computed, unlike the real VAT maths in getOrCreateInvoice()
Payment outcome is Math.random() > 0.25 after a fixed 1.8s delay; the adjacent comment claims ~80% success, contradicting the threshold
tryAnotherCard()'s four card inputs have no ids and are never read; 'Save & charge' re-enters processCharge() with the same hardcoded Visa
The 'Keep same driver?' toggle in wizard step 1 has no id and is never read — it is purely decorative
openRenewFlow() falls back to the hardcoded demo rider RDR-1041 when called with a falsy id, silently renewing the wrong rider's subscription
Wizard options advertise 'Save 5%', 'Save 10%' and '5% discount applied' but prices are read straight out of PLANS — no discount is ever applied
Only nav.renewal carries data-i18n; every heading, KPI label, badge, modal string and button produced in JS is an untranslatable English literal
priorityCall(name, context, entityId) is wired to the 'Priority call' button but its 3-argument contract and effect were not traced

modules.name: Trip Readiness (pre-departure monitoring)
modules.purpose: Pre-departure watchtower for subscription trips. It reads DB.upcomingSubTrips, assigns each trip a four-level readiness state from driver availability, driver movement and rider confirmation weighed against minutes-until-departure, groups the table by urgency, and offers per-row remediation: call rider, call/nudge driver, find a replacement, notify the rider, postpone, or raise a support ticket.

findings.summary: sendRiderChangeNotif() reassigns the trip's driver with no permission check and no audit entry — a second, ungated path to the write that confirmReassign gates behind manage_subscriptions
The notif-msg textarea is never read and no notification is dispatched — the operator's edited message is discarded while the toast claims the rider was notified
No compensation is ever applied: finalizeReassign writes no wallet credit, promo or credit note, only an audit line and a toast

finalizeReassign's label map keys the discount as '-20off' while the radio's data-comp is '20off', so the default selection falls through to the raw string and the toast and audit read 'Compensation: 20off'
finalizeReassign has no permission gate even though the preceding confirmReassign does, and it is globally reachable on window

resolveUnavailable's candidate list filters only on vehicle type and takes the first three keys — a busy, suspended or ineligible driver can be offered as the replacement, unlike assignBackup and nearestAvailableDrivers
Trips never leave the board on departure: minutesUntil stops decrementing at 0 and only confirmPostponeTrip removes a record, so a departed trip stays pinned in Critical/High forever
The 'Upcoming (24h)' tile counts the entire DB.upcomingSubTrips array — no 24-hour filter exists, and seeded trips 21-22 hours out are already included
The sidebar badge sums three overlapping KPI sets, so a trip that is both unavailable and unconfirmed within 60 min is counted twice and the badge can exceed the number of trips needing attention
logCallOutcome ignores two of its four outcomes — 'cancelled' and 'delay' produce only a toast, so a rider who asked to cancel leaves no record anywhere
logDriverCall's 'delay' outcome writes nothing despite the toast claiming the rider will be notified

readinessStatus and tripScenario disagree on the unconfirmed case (high/red vs unconfirmed/amber) and readinessStatus has no unassigned case, despite the source comment asserting the two can never disagree
createReadinessTicket writes no audit entry and has no permission gate, unlike most other ops writes in the file
logNdvContact records nothing at all — no state, no audit — so the three driver-contact outcome options in the nearby-drivers modal are cosmetic
The DB.upcomingSubTrips 'NAV SAFETY NET' fallback seed can never execute because the array is unconditionally assigned first

createReadinessTicket derives the ticket id as 'TKT-'+(505+DB.tickets.length), which collides if a ticket is ever deleted

Only nav.readiness carries data-i18n; the page heading, four KPI labels, both sort buttons, every table header, badge, section band, empty state and all seven modals are English literals

modules.name: Requests (subscription sign-ups + instant rides)
modules.purpose: One queue for the two ways a rider can ask for service: instant ride requests (DB.rideRequests, matched automatically by tickEngine with ops intervening only on SLA breach) and subscription sign-ups (DB.subscriptionRequests, matched manually by ops against a hotel-style payment authorization hold captured on assignment or released on timeout). The module also owns two full-list sub-pages, #p-requests-sub-all (L2123-L2141) and #p-requests-instant-all (L2144-L2162), each with its own search box, page-size select and pager.

approveDriver generates 'DRV-0'+(106+random*90) with no collision check; DRV-0106 already exists and would be silently overwritten

finalizeReassign has no permission gate, unlike its sibling commitLiveReassign which requires live_ops

findings.summary: Two incompatible document sets: a.docs uses license/id_card/vehicle_reg/background/insurance while DOC_TYPES uses license/vehicle_reg/inspection/insurance/operating_card, so id_card and background never get an expiry date and inspection and operating_card can never be inspected or rejected

Approving a document has no permission gate and writes no audit entry, while rejecting one requires approve_drivers and is fully audited — an operator without the permission can mark every KYC document verified
A rejected document renders identically to a pending one in both applicant lists because applicantRowHTML only tests for a leading ✓ and falls back to b-amber
The approval modal's document warning counts ✗ Rejected documents as 'still pending automated verification', producing soft advisory copy for an explicitly refused scan

Nothing blocks approval: approveDriver reads none of a.docs, a.docNotes, a.docExpiry, a.bank.status or the vehicle-class verdict, so a mismatched class, a rejected licence and an unverified bank account can all be approved in two clicks
New driver id 'DRV-0'+(106+random*90) has no uniqueness check and DRV-0106 already exists; a collision silently overwrites a live driver together with its trips, payments and complaints
The rejection modal promises 'This applicant will be notified' but rejectDriver sends no email and pushes no notification; only approval calls sendSystemEmail

reconsiderApplicant sets status back to pending but never clears a.reason/decidedBy/decidedAt and never re-renders the lists; cancelling the chained approval modal leaves a 'pending' applicant carrying a stale rejection reason

decidedBy is hardcoded 'Sarah Al-Rashid' on both approve and reject while logAction resolves the real CURRENT_USER_ID, so the applicant record and the audit trail can attribute one decision to two people

confirmApproveDriver and confirmRejectDriver have no permission gate; the block only fires on the final button, so a denial toast appears after the operator has read a screen implying the action is available
saveDocExpiry writes blank inputs as empty strings; approveDriver's enteredExpiry[key]||defaultExpiry then treats '' as falsy and silently substitutes today+1 year
The save_doc_expiry audit entry passes empty before/after objects, so the actual dates exist only in the free-text summary and cannot be diffed
approveDriver re-opens the applicant detail page without isBack, pushing a history frame, so Back after an approval returns to the same page instead of the list (setDocStatus correctly passes true)
The submitted-documents card is guarded only by 'a && a.docs' with no isApproved check, so the ✓/✕ buttons stay live after the driver has been created and edits there affect nothing downstream
The triage card footer uses DB.pendingDrivers.length > 3 (all applications) while the list slices only open ones, so 'View all pending applications →' can appear beneath a one-row list
a.plate is displayed on the applicant page but never copied into DB.drivers, so an approved driver's Vehicle card shows 'Plate number: —' and the All-Pending plate search can no longer find them
go() calls renderAllPending('') unconditionally, including on Back, while the #pending-search input keeps its typed value — the list and the box disagree until the next keystroke
All-Pending has no status filter, no sort and no pagination; decided and open applications interleave in array order and a.applied is unsortable free text
renderAllPending dereferences a.plate unguarded, so an applicant record without a plate would throw and blank the whole list

fleetCounts().drivers.pending is structurally always 0 and is displayed as 'Pending approval' directly above a card showing 5, because the two numbers read DB.drivers[*].status and DB.pendingDrivers[*].status respectively

modules.name: Riders
modules.purpose: The demand-side roster. Top to bottom it answers who just signed up (the ✨ New sign-ups intake card with a one-click welcome offer), who is worth saving before they leave (the ⚠ Retention watchlist, the intersection of high lifetime value and non-Low churn risk), and everyone else (the All riders table with live-computed LTV and churn risk and a risk-level filter). Every analytic on the page is derived from DB at render time — there are no stored rider-analytics fields.

kpis.name: On a subscription
kpis.formula: DB.subscriptions values where /active|expiring/i.test(s.status) — counts SUBSCRIPTIONS, not riders

kpis.name: Lifetime value (LTV)
kpis.formula: Σ over pid in d.payments of (DB.payments[pid].status==='Paid' ? parseFloat(amount)||0 : 0)
kpis.thresholds: rendered .toFixed(2)+' SAR'; Refunded and Pending payments contribute nothing

kpis.name: Tenure (months)
kpis.formula: max(1, (EYVAR_TODAY.getFullYear()-joinedYear)*12 + (EYVAR_TODAY.getMonth()-joinedMonth)) from the 'Mon YYYY' joined string; 1 when unparseable

kpis.name: Churn risk score
kpis.formula: +1 no subscription at all; +2 auto-renew off; +2 has a cancelled subscription; +complaints.length; +1 rating (default 5) below 4

kpis.name: Rider health
kpis.thresholds: h-red / h-amber / h-green; rating 0 is falsy so a zero-rated rider reads Healthy

kpis.name: Page subtitle (renderRidersTable version)
kpis.formula: ids.length + ' total · ' + count(subs.length>0) + ' with active subscription · ' + count(no subs) + ' quick-ride only · ' + DB.newRiders.length + ' new (24h)'

kpis.name: Page subtitle (liveSubtitles version)
kpis.formula: c.riders.total + ' registered · ' + c.riders.withSub + ' with an active subscription · ' + c.riders.quickOnly + ' quick-ride only'

findings.summary: The 'On a subscription' and 'Quick-ride only' KPI tiles count subscriptions, not riders — a rider with two active subs is double-counted and quickOnly can go negative
#new-riders-count is static HTML text '3' and no JS ever writes it, so the New sign-ups badge is permanently wrong once DB.newRiders changes

Two contradictory page subtitles write the same

: renderRidersTable counts riders with a non-empty subs[] while liveSubtitles counts active/expiring subscriptions, and whichever ran last wins

The Status column reads 'Active' whenever subs[] is non-empty, ignoring the subscription's real status and ignoring rr.suspended entirely — a rider whose only subscription is Cancelled still shows Active

The riders table renders no flagged or suspended badge even though commitFlagAccount/commitSuspendAccount call renderRidersTable() afterwards and the flag modal promises the flag is visible 'in the Riders table'; the drivers table renders both
The Vehicle column defaults to 'Economy' for subscription-less riders, presenting a fabricated value identically to a real one

riderLTV's parseFloat(p.amount) does not strip thousands separators, so a payment of '1,040.00 SAR' would contribute 1 while numOf() elsewhere strips them correctly — latent, no seed payment has a comma
riderTenureMonths cannot parse DB.newRiders joined strings ('25 Jun · today'), so every promoted new rider permanently shows Tenure 1 mo and a correspondingly inflated avg monthly spend

openNewRiderProfile drops gender, hasPhoto, device, appLang, lastIp, ipLocation and movementLog on promotion, and never removes the entry from DB.newRiders — the rider stays in the sign-ups card forever and is double-counted
riderHealth treats rating 0 as Healthy (rr.rating && …) while riderChurnRisk scores the same rider +1 for being below 4★ — the two disagree on the same record
riderChurnRisk's variable named activeSubs actually holds ALL subscriptions, so a rider whose only sub is Cancelled gets +2 from the cancelled rule but escapes the +1 'no subscription' rule

riderLTV walks only d.payments[] while entityDerived() scans DB.payments by entity, so a payment recorded against a rider but not appended to their array is counted by the profile's provenance line and not by LTV
'Send retention offer' sends a real promo email with no confirmation and no permission gate, while confirmWelcomeOffer on the same page requires contact_users
stats.renewalRate is a display-only seed string that is never computed anywhere in the file, yet it occupies a column of the roster
getReferralCode(riderId) is defined and never called, so rider.referralCode is never generated or displayed
rider.referredBy is written by processReferral() but never read or rendered anywhere
rider.driverGenderPref is consumed by dispatch but never surfaced on the Riders page or in buildEntityProfile, so ops cannot see or change it
dob and nid are stored on rider records (and copied on promotion) but rendered nowhere — the rider Personal-information card shows only Gender, Address and City
The level-pill class map falls through to b-red for any lvl outside gold/silver/new, so a rider with lvl 'standard' gets a red pill; lvlBadge() maps the same value to grey/Standard
No column sorting, no table search, no pagination, no bulk action and no export on the Riders page; the KPI tiles are also not clickable, unlike the Drivers page's supply tiles
initCardToggles() is only called from openProfile, so none of the three cards on this page can be collapsed
subs['riders'] seeds the toolbar subtitle as '284 registered riders' against a 10-rider seed DB and is never recomputed for this page
All findings for this page come from static source reading; the panel was never loaded in a browser, so load-order behaviour and CSS effects on .health/.b-com/.ra are inferred rather than observed

modules.name: 360° Profile system
modules.purpose: A single shared page shell reused for six entity types. openProfile(id) resolves any raw id or name through resolveId() against DB.riders, DB.drivers, DB.trips, DB.subscriptions, DB.payments and DB.complaints, sets a type-specific header and meta line, and hands #prof-body to one of five builder functions. It is the app-wide drill-down target reached from 40+ call sites, the global search box and every rowLink().

kpis.name: Total trips (rider)
kpis.formula: stat.totalTrips || '-' with provenanceChip('stored') plus a derived sub-line from entityDerived(d.id).trips

kpis.name: Total paid (rider)
kpis.formula: stat.totalPaid || '-' with provenanceChip('stored') plus a derived sub-line entityDerived(d.id).paid.toFixed(2)

kpis.name: Renewal rate (rider)
kpis.formula: stat.renewalRate || '-' - never computed anywhere in the file

kpis.name: Total trips (driver)
kpis.formula: stat.totalTrips || '-' - raw, no provenance chip, no derived sub-line

kpis.name: Derived trips / payments / paid
kpis.formula: entityDerived(id): trips = keys of DB.trips where (isDrv ? t.driver===id : t.rider===id); paid = sum over DB.payments where p.entity===id of (p.status==='Paid' ? parseFloat(p.amount)||0 : 0)

kpis.name: Reconciliation divergence
kpis.formula: reconcileEntity: cmp(label, stored, derived) flags a row when numOf(stored)!=null and Math.abs(stored-derived)>=0.01; override sets orphan = stored>0 && windowSplit(id).inside===0
kpis.thresholds: tolerance 0.01; orphan when the window holds zero records

kpis.name: Data-window split
kpis.formula: windowStartMs() = nowMs() - 13*30.44*86400000; windowSplit partitions the entity trips into inside / older / total, and a trip with no dateMs counts as inside

kpis.name: Rider no-show total
kpis.formula: reports (DB.fairnessCases where subjectId===riderId and reasonCode==='DRV_RIDER_NOSHOW' and openedAtMs >= nowMs()-counterWindowDays*86400000) + trips (DB.trips where t.rider===riderId and /no-?show/i.test(t.status))
kpis.thresholds: heavy = total >= 3 gives a red border and a b-red pill; otherwise b-amber

kpis.name: Driver earnings breakdown
kpis.formula: escrow held/ready summed from DB.escrowHolds; tips = sum of (t.tip||0) over DB.trips where t.driver===d.id; bonuses = sum over DB.driverBonusLog where b.driverId===d.id; pending deductions = sum over DB.deductions where x.driver===d.id and x.status==='pending'

kpis.name: Customer value (LTV / avg monthly / tenure / churn risk)
kpis.formula: riderLTV, riderTenureMonths and riderChurnRisk - formulas written out in 09a section 5

Doc line numbers drift from source in several places - reviewDriver, the wallet and tip modal functions, and the DB seed block ranges
creditRiderWallet and debitRiderWallet are wrapped later in the file with idempotency and double-entry ledger posting, which the doc's wallet-adjust description omits

modules.name: Captain Fairness
modules.purpose: The appeal route for the supply side: suspension appeals, rating disputes and captain-reported rider issues all land here as coded fairness cases in DB.fairnessCases, each decided Upheld or Overturned with a corrective action per case kind. The page also carries a captain-economics table measuring SAR earned per engaged hour, explicitly labelled an upper bound because only on-trip minutes are known.

kpis.name: Open cases
kpis.thresholds: value colour var(--amber) when above 0, else var(--ink)

kpis.name: Overturn rate
kpis.formula: decided.length ? Math.round(overturned/decided.length*100) : 0, where decided = cases with status!=='Open' and overturned = decided with status==='Overturned'

kpis.name: Fleet average SAR per engaged hour
kpis.formula: rows.length ? sum(r.perHour)/rows.length : 0 - a mean of per-captain rates, not total earnings divided by total hours

kpis.formula: sum of (parseFloat(t.min)||0) over DB.trips where t.driver===id and /done/i.test(t.status)

findings.summary: No page-level permission entry and no gate on case filing - only decideFairness checks approve_drivers
c.rationale is initialised to null and never written or displayed, so no reason is recorded for any fairness decision
An upheld case has zero downstream effect beyond the status string - no strike, no note on the driver record and no captain notification, although the gate copy promises one
Overturning a Rider report has no code path - the corrective branches cover only Rating dispute and Suspension appeal
The fleet average is a mean of per-captain rates rather than total earnings over total hours, so a captain with one short trip weighs the same as one with hundreds
renderFairnessPage never refreshes the sidebar badge, so deciding a case from the page leaves sbb-fairness stale until updateContactsBadge next runs
No de-duplication of cases - a captain can file unlimited rating disputes on the same trip, and the suspension-appeal duplicate check exists only in the UI
An overturned rating dispute always voids the score but can only recompute the historical average when ratingCount > 1, leaving a stale seeded average behind otherwise
All four KPI tiles are inert - no onclick, no filter, no search and no sort anywhere on the page
c.disputedRating is stored on rating-dispute cases but never rendered
c.date from fmtReqNowLabel is stored but never rendered on this page
The three modals reuse the same textarea id fc-detail; it works only because one modal is open at a time
sameCaptainStats and onTimeStats are defined in this module block but called by neither renderer here
captainEconomics folds tips into earn while the on-screen caveat mentions only engaged time
The doc records the driver fixture as five captains DRV-0101 to DRV-0105; the source seeds six, DRV-0101 to DRV-0106
rcLabel returns labelEn only, so the bilingual Arabic reason-code labels never appear on this page and no element carries data-i18n except the sidebar item
ownershipWarning, caseChip and ownerChip behaviour was not read - they belong to the ownership and case modules

modules.name: Plan Commitment
modules.purpose: Two ordered layers over subscription legs: prevention (nightly confirmation by a 21:00 cut-off, acknowledgement weighting, backup offers and departure-risk calls) and enforcement (a rolling 30-day absence counter with a three-tier ladder that forfeits undelivered plan earnings, freezes and finally terminates plan access). It also owns emergency dispatch - the nearest-captain search that covers a stranded rider - and the emergency-claim appeal route back.

kpis.name: Awaiting captain reply
kpis.formula: pend.filter(p => an offerState in offered/expired/declined, or p.confirmed with legAck(p.subId).weight==='weak').length

kpis.name: Departure risk
kpis.formula: departureRisk().filter(r => r.minsToPickup <= 20).length - given the minsToPickup formula this filter never excludes anything

kpis.name: Live absences (30d)
kpis.formula: DB.absenceEvents.filter(e => !e.waived && !e.decayed).length, with a sub-label summing e.forfeited

kpis.name: Real backup coverage
kpis.formula: coverageStats().eligiblePct, sub-label registeredPct - rendered only when coverageStats and DB.backupRegistry exist

kpis.name: Emergency claims
kpis.thresholds: var(--amber) when above 0; each is due within appealResponseHours (24h)

kpis.name: Absence count (rolling)
kpis.thresholds: tier 1 at 1, tier 2 at 2, tier 3 at 3 and above (nextTier caps at the last tier)

kpis.name: Absence exposure
kpis.formula: driverShare = paid*0.8; remaining = max(0, driverShare*((total-done)/total)); totalAtRisk = remaining + commitmentReserve(subId)

kpis.name: Commitment reserve
kpis.formula: pct = DB.commitPolicy.commitmentReservePct || 0; returns 0 when pct is 0 (ships disabled), else round(paid*0.8*(pct/100)*100)/100

kpis.name: Regulator counter
kpis.formula: DB.absenceEvents.filter(e => e.driverId===id && e.tsMs >= nowMs()-30*86400000 && !e.waived).length - hardcoded 30 days and ignores .decayed
kpis.thresholds: red when count >= regulatorCancelLimit-1 (4); GAT suspension at 5

kpis.name: Replacement pay
kpis.formula: round(baseFare * multiplierPct/100 * 100)/100 where baseFare = round((paid/totalTrips)*100)/100 and multiplierPct is 125 for a standing backup or 150 for a nearest-captain search

kpis.name: Rider delay compensation
kpis.formula: pct = min(riderCompCapPct 100, ceil(delayMin/10)*riderCompPctPer10Min 20); return max(riderCompMinSAR 10, round(fare*(pct/100)*100)/100)
kpis.thresholds: floor 10 SAR, cap 100% of the leg

kpis.name: Eyvar net cost per dispatch
kpis.formula: round((replacementPay - recovered + riderCompensation)*100)/100 where recovered = min(replacementPay, absenceEvent.forfeited)

kpis.name: Coverage stats
kpis.formula: registeredPct = registered/rows.length*100; eligiblePct = eligible/rows.length*100; uncovered = rows where no eligible registered backup and an empty fallback pool
kpis.thresholds: the gap between registeredPct and eligiblePct is called out in red on the page

kpis.name: Rehabilitation clock
kpis.formula: cleanMs = nowMs() - max tsMs over the driver's non-waived absences; eligible when cleanMs >= rehabDays(90)*86400000; remainingDays = max(0, 90 - floor(cleanMs/86400000))

findings.summary: The 21:00 confirmation deadline is never evaluated by code - confirmDeadline appears only in display strings and an operator must hand off manually
Forfeiture is logged and never posted - recordAbsence writes an audit line but debits no wallet, escrow or payout record, and an upheld claim restores money only in the audit summary
Departure-risk minutes to pickup are a deterministic pseudo-value computed from the trip id digits, presented on screen as a countdown

No PAGE_PERMISSIONS entry and no permission check on recordAbsence, autoHandoff, confirmPlanLeg or acceptEmergency - only the two decide handlers check approve_drivers, so an unprivileged operator can terminate a captain's plan access behind a confirm dialog alone
saveCommitPolicy's ceiling validation multiplies regulatorCancelLimit by 0, so the guard collapses to freezeDays > 30
regulatorCount ignores decayed events while absenceCount honours them, so the two counters diverge silently
regulatorCount hardcodes 30 days instead of reading counterWindowDays, so changing the window in Settings desynchronises the internal and statutory counters
tier.demoteTier is display-only - no code ever demotes d.lvl
Probation is written but never enforced - planProbation and planProbationUntilMs are read nowhere and recordAbsence has no probation branch
A rejected emergency claim captures no grounds although both the gate copy and the toast insist the grounds must be served to the captain
dispatchWindowSec (45s) is display-only - nothing expires a dispatch offer; the only real timeout is the 20-minute offerWindowMin on backup offers
appealWindowDays (7) is never enforced - openEmergencyClaim performs no age check on the absence
acceptPlanTerms is never called from any UI and DB.termsAcceptances is never rendered, despite the save gate promising captains must re-accept when the terms version changes
Dispatch acceptance and decline are labelled Simulate - there is no real captain-response channel
The captain-preview card always renders the exposure line for the first driver in the fixture
The driver share is hardcoded as paid*0.8 in two places rather than deriving from EYVAR_COMMISSION_PCT, so a commission change silently desynchronises every exposure figure
acceptEmergency is wrapped later in the file with idempotency and double-entry ledger postings, which the doc's money-mechanics section omits and which qualifies its 'logged, never posted' claim
renderCommitmentPage never refreshes #sbb-commit, so the sidebar count goes stale after confirming a leg until updateContactsBadge next runs
The risk filter key does nothing - KPI 3 sets _commitFilter and scrolls, but the risk card always renders the full array
The awaiting filter has no entry in the filter-chip label map, so the chip shows the raw key
tier.forfeitRemaining is declared on all three tiers but never read - recordAbsence forfeits unconditionally
reserveState is defined and never called
ev.reserveForfeited is stored on every absence event and never displayed
ev.appealId is initialised to null and never written - only emergencyId is used
riderWaitMin, riderNoShowPayPct and payoutDays are editable in Settings but read nowhere in this module
The absence ladder is rendered read-only in Settings even though every scalar policy value is editable
Distance and ETA are synthetic - gridDistanceKm uses map-grid coordinates scaled by 0.42 and returns 99 for a missing position
Three doc line citations are off by one against source - minsToPickup, the driver-share constant and the under-earner threshold
Explicit boot-order fragility - the page guards coverageStats, DB.backupRegistry, renderEmergencyDispatch and DB.planConfirmations because it is built by an earlier module's boot step
newCase, linkToCase, caseFor, creditRiderWallet, logGoodwill and ownershipWarning semantics were not read - they belong to modules outside this group

findings.summary: No way to create an incident — DB.incidents is only ever .find()-ed and .filter()-ed; there is no push, no 'log incident' button and no SOS ingestion path, so in a live system the queue could never receive anything

No way to lift a precautionary suspension: precautionSuspend writes a reason starting 'Precautionary' while the only deletion site (Compliance's auto-lift) requires the prefix 'Expired', and closeIncident never touches DB.complianceSuspensions

#sbb-safety is set only inside renderSafetyPage() and the tick engine has no safety hook at all, so an operator who never opens the page sees 0 next to 'Safety' indefinitely while two incidents are open
No way to reopen a closed incident despite the confirm text explicitly promising 'reopen it manually if new information comes in later'
filterSafety('all') is unreachable from the UI — no tile calls it, tile 4 navigates away instead, and the filter survives navigation, so only a full reload restores the unfiltered list
KPI 2 counts open+critical incidents but the filter it triggers matches severity regardless of status, so the tile's number and the list it produces can disagree
KPI 3 'Closed this month' counts every closed incident ever — DB.incidents has no date field that could be filtered and 'opened' is free text
The queue never sorts by severity — only open-before-closed — so a 'high' incident can render above a 🆘 CRITICAL one; the seed order currently masks this
A permission denial in toggleIncStep returns before renderSafetyPage(), leaving the checkbox visually flipped while DB.incidents is unchanged — the UI lies until the next render
Un-ticking a step replaces the object wholesale with {done:false}, irrecoverably destroying the by/at attribution the module's own comment calls an accountability trail
precautionSuspend force-completes protocol step 'act' (overwriting any prior by/at) without a matching logAction('incident_step',…), so the Activity log shows a step count changing with no step event
Inconsistent gating between destructive actions: precautionSuspend requires approve_drivers AND safety.suspend, while closeIncident requires only safety.close with no broad-permission check
safety.view is declared in PAGE_PERMISSIONS but never enforced — no canPage('safety','view') call exists

The 'Normal' severity branch is unreachable with today's data and there is no UI to set a severity at all
'incident' is a first-class audit entityType but incidents are not in resolveId()'s bucket list, so an audit row for an incident cannot be clicked through to its record
Three of four KPI bar widths are fixed constants (25% / 33% / 10%) and the fourth uses an arbitrary ×25 scale

perUserLimit, target and expires are inert — no validation, no matching and no clock comparison anywhere; 'Specific zone' stores the literal string with no zone picker and is not wired to DB.zones
MSG_SEGMENTS recipient counts are hardcoded and never recomputed, even though broadcastAudienceCount and pushAudienceIds exist in Settings

processReferral writes referee.referredBy but no other reference to referredBy exists — a dead write
commitProcessReferral credits two wallets but is gated only on contact_users — no finance-shaped permission is required for an action that moves money
Referral bonus inputs accept any positive value with no upper bound, and parseFloat(...)||0 silently coerces junk to 0
pausePromo is confirm-gated but resumePromo is not, despite sharing the growth.pause_promo permission

modules.purpose: Revenue-and-giveback ledger view: a hardcoded KPI strip and static Revenue-by-plan table, a live contribution-margin model that subtracts every giveback from gross margin, the refunds ledger rendered from DB.refunds, and the credit-notes card that reverses VAT on each refund. The page itself is read-only - it contains no button that moves money; every movement it displays is created elsewhere (subscription cancellation, the wallet modal, cash reconciliation) and merely reported here.

kpis.name: Refunds ledger counter (#refunds-total)
kpis.formula: total = DB.refunds.reduce(function(s,r){return s+r.amount;},0); label = DB.refunds.length+' refund'+(DB.refunds.length===1?'':'s')+' . '+fmtSAR(total)+' total'

kpis.name: Emergency cover (giveback)

kpis.name: Total giveback

kpis.name: True margin %

kpis.name: Credit-note VAT split (issueCreditNote)
kpis.formula: rate = DB.vatConfig.ratePct/100; totalIncl = Math.round(entry.amount*100)/100; subtotal = Math.round((totalIncl/(1+rate))*100)/100; vatAmount = Math.round((totalIncl-subtotal)*100)/100

kpis.name: Refund ledger posting (idempotency override)
kpis.formula: net = r2(amount/(1+rate)); vat = r2(amount-net); postLedger(key,'refund',[{contra.refunds debit net},{tax.vat_output debit vat},{cash.gateway credit r2(amount)}])
kpis.thresholds: balances exactly because net + vat === r2(amount) by construction

kpis.formula: used=parseInt(trips[0])||0; total=parseInt(trips[1])||1; grossRefund=Math.round(parseFloat(sub.paid)*Math.max(0,(total-used)/total)*100)/100; feeApplies = used>0 && rule.enabled && grossRefund>0; fee = feeApplies ? Math.round(grossRefund*(rule.feePct/100)*100)/100 : 0; refund = Math.round((grossRefund-fee)*100)/100

kpis.name: Ledger reconciliation diff

findings.summary: Subscription cancellation books the same refund twice - recordRefund AND creditRiderWallet are called with the identical amount
recordRefund has no permission gate of its own; its only protection is a confirm modal that window.__skipGuards disables globally
Refund amount is unbounded - only amount>0 is validated, with no ceiling, no comparison to the original payment, and no role authority check
demoDoubleRefund() is a production-reachable global that issues two real 25.00 SAR refunds with no permission check and no confirmation of its own
findInvoiceForRefund falls back to an arbitrary Paid payment for the rider and marks the credit note unlinked:false - a VAT reversal filed against an unrelated invoice
The refund idempotency key carries no timestamp, so two legitimately distinct identical refunds collapse and the second is silently suppressed
A refund never marks its source payment Refunded, so refunded money keeps counting toward contributionMargin().gross and riderLTV
Refund IDs derive from DB.refunds.length+1 rather than a monotonic sequence, so any deletion or reorder produces duplicate REF ids
contributionMargin sums driverEarn over ALL trips with no status filter while gross filters status Paid - cancelled trips depress net with no matching revenue line
recordRefund writes no logAction of its own - the refund reaches the audit trail only as a side effect of the caller or of the credit note
The finance page permission is declared in PAGE_PERMISSIONS but requirePagePerm('finance','view') is never called anywhere, and view_finance is never passed to requirePerm
liability.escrow and the payout side of liability.driver are declared in the chart of accounts but never posted to, leaving the trial balance structurally incomplete for all driver money
All seven KPI tiles are static strings that contradict both the static table beneath them and the live wallets data an operator would read them as current
Credit-note 'unlinked' is a terminal dead end - the modal and the ops notification both tell finance to link it, but no linking UI or function exists
ledgerReconcile's refund row can never balance: the VAT term is multiplied by zero, so a VAT-inclusive ops total is compared against VAT-exclusive contra.refunds
backfillCreditNotes issues credit notes with no ledger posting at all, so backfilled notes have no contra.refunds / tax.vat_output entry
Payment amounts are stored as strings and parsed with parseFloat everywhere; a comma-grouped string such as '1,640.00 SAR' parses to 1 with no error
Every refund is stamped with the frozen demo date '25 Jun' and the credit note inherits it as issuedAt - on a document whose whole purpose is tax-period attribution
The contribution card and the credit-notes list are not in the boot render list, so both stay blank until the user navigates to the page
DB.payments has no runtime writer - the collection is read-only seed data and its status field has no state machine
Refund rows are immutable - renderRefundsTable offers no void, reverse, re-issue, or edit action
findInvoiceForRefund tests p.sub===rel but no payment record has a sub field, so the clause is permanently false
accountBalance('tax.vat_output')*0 in ledgerReconcile contributes nothing to the comparison
The 'No refunds issued this session.' empty state is unreachable while the two seed refunds exist
statusBadge('Paid') matches none of the four regexes and renders b-grey, identical to an unknown status
No filter, search, sort, date range, export, or pagination on the refunds ledger or the credit-note list
payTable renders money with no per-column totals row
The sub_before_first_trip cancellation rule is never read by any code; the used>0 test is what actually implements 'no fee before the first trip'
The ar.rider and expense.emergency accounts are declared in ACCOUNTS but never posted to
The DB.refunds seed comment asserts the referenced subscriptions are outside the active list, but SUB-0998 and SUB-0987 are both present in DB.subscriptions

Several doc line references are off by one to three lines against the source (renderRefundsTable body, renderCreditNotes body, issueCreditNote fields, confirmCancelSub, getCancellationRule, postLedger, PERMISSION_LABELS)

modules.name: Driver Wallets
modules.purpose: The driver-side money page, carrying four distinct financial subsystems on one screen: quick-ride payouts payable on trip completion (DB.payouts), subscription escrow held until a plan is fully delivered (DB.escrowHolds), penalties subtracted from the pending payout (DB.deductions), and cash reconciliation, which compares a GPS-and-pricing expected fare against what the driver reports collecting and accrues a running debt with a hard cap that suspends cash collection (DB.cashLedger / DB.driverCashDebt).

kpis.name: Available now (quick rides) #avail-now-kpi
kpis.formula: totalPending = Object.keys(DB.payouts) accumulated over p.pending; rendered totalPending.toFixed(2)
kpis.thresholds: fixed inline var(--green); no conditional colouring

kpis.name: Available now sub-line #avail-now-sub
kpis.formula: (count of ids where DB.payouts[id].pending > 0) + ' driver(s) with balance due'

kpis.name: Total driver debt outstanding #cash-debt-kpi
kpis.formula: totalDebt = Object.keys(DB.driverCashDebt) accumulated over Math.max(0, -DB.driverCashDebt[k]); rendered fmtSAR(totalDebt)
kpis.thresholds: the Math.max(0,...) term excludes credit balances rather than netting them off

kpis.name: Escalated to Trust & Safety #cash-escalated-kpi
kpis.thresholds: sub-line reads 'repeat pattern detected' but the metric counts every escalation

kpis.name: Drivers over debt cap #cash-blocked-kpi
kpis.formula: count of Object.keys(DB.driverCashDebt) where driverCashBlocked(k), i.e. DB.driverCashDebt[k] <= CASH_DEBT_CAP

kpis.name: #escrow-count badge
kpis.formula: DB.escrowHolds.length - ALL statuses, not just held
kpis.thresholds: class b b-amber, the same amber used for the held state

kpis.name: Cash debt accrual (applyCashDebtImpact)
kpis.formula: commissionOwed = Math.round(entry.expectedFare * CASH_COMMISSION_RATE * 100)/100; entry.debtAdded = Math.round((commissionOwed + (entry.topupAmount||0))*100)/100; DB.driverCashDebt[entry.driver] = Math.round(((DB.driverCashDebt[entry.driver]||0) - entry.debtAdded)*100)/100
kpis.thresholds: CASH_COMMISSION_RATE = 0.20; rounded to 2 dp at every step so the total does not drift

kpis.name: Cash classification (classifyCashReport)
kpis.formula: dev = reportedMinusTopup - expected; if(Math.abs(dev) <= CASH_TOLERANCE) return 'match'; return dev > CASH_TOLERANCE ? 'over_report' : 'under_report'

kpis.name: Cash-collection suspension (driverCashBlocked)
kpis.thresholds: suspended once the driver owes 300.00 SAR or more

kpis.name: Repeat-pattern counter (driverCashRiskCount)
kpis.thresholds: isPattern when count >= 2; lifetime-in-session, no rolling window and no decay

kpis.name: Cash deviation display
kpis.formula: deviation = reportedAmount != null ? (reportedAmount - topupAmount - expectedFare) : null; display = (deviation>=0?'+':'')+fmtSAR(deviation)

kpis.name: Escrow progress bar %
kpis.formula: Math.round(e.tripsCompleted / e.tripsRequired * 100) - NO zero-guard on tripsRequired
kpis.thresholds: rf-g fill when ready, rf-a fill when held

kpis.name: Payout after deduction (confirmApplyDeduction)
kpis.thresholds: clamped at 0 - any excess penalty is discarded with no carry-forward

kpis.name: Deduction preview 'Balance after deduction'
kpis.formula: avail = DB.payouts[d.driver] ? p.pending : 0; Math.max(0, avail - d.amount).toFixed(2) + ' SAR'
kpis.thresholds: clamped at 0, so it shows 0.00 without indicating the excess evaporated

kpis.name: Pay one driver (payDriver)
kpis.formula: amt = p.pending; p.paidOut += amt; p.pending = 0; p.lastPayout='Just now'; p.deductionNote=null - a hard zero, not a subtraction; p.earned is untouched and DB.driverCashDebt is never consulted
kpis.thresholds: guard: return when !p || p.pending <= 0; no rounding anywhere

kpis.name: Escrow release (releaseEscrow)
kpis.formula: DB.escrowHolds.splice(idx,1); p = ensurePayoutEntry(e.driver); p.pending += e.amount; p.earned += e.amount
kpis.thresholds: no rounding; e.status is never checked

kpis.name: Earnings-statement per-trip commission
kpis.thresholds: no totals row; the source is d.trips (the whole trip array), not the payout cycle

kpis.name: Driver risk-score cash-debt penalty
kpis.thresholds: -30 when suspended; a reason string only when in debt but not blocked

kpis.name: Tip simulation (simulateTip)
kpis.thresholds: tips go 100% to the driver and are never added to DB.payouts.pending
