findings.summary: waiveDeduction is completely ungoverned - no requirePerm, no requirePagePerm, no confirmation modal, and no logAction; one click permanently dismisses a penalty with no record of who did it
releaseEscrow never checks the hold's status - the ready test lives only in the renderer, so calling the global releases an incomplete 4-of-5-trip hold
confirmApplyDeduction has no re-apply guard - it reads prevStatus only for the audit diff and then unconditionally subtracts again, so a second call double-deducts
commitCashResolve and commitCashRepayment are unguarded globals - window.commitCashRepayment('DRV-0103') clears that driver's entire cash debt with no permission check

Four of the six declared wallets page permissions are never enforced; payout, escrow and deduction actions use the legacy global permissions instead, so revoking wallets.process_payouts does not stop a payout
executePayout renders a 'Payment sent' success screen and writes a driver notification unconditionally, even when payDriver refused the transfer for lack of permission

No idempotency on any driver-money action - payDriver, confirmProcessAll, releaseEscrow, confirmApplyDeduction and commitCashRepayment are never wrapped in withIdempotency, so double-submit safety is accidental
Deduction overflow is silently discarded - Math.max(0, p.pending - d.amount) drops the excess with no carry-forward, no negative balance, and no warning
Cash debt accrues on honest reports - applyCashDebtImpact runs for every generated event including match and over_report, so a truthful driver eventually hits the -300 cap and is suspended
Cash-debt auto-deduction from payouts is promised in three places in the UI but no code path connects DB.driverCashDebt to DB.payouts - a driver with 250 SAR of debt is paid in full

No driver-money movement reaches the ledger - neither releaseEscrow, payDriver, confirmProcessAll, confirmApplyDeduction nor any cash function calls postLedger, and liability.driver is credited on accrual but never debited on settlement
The escrow lifecycle is not implemented - nothing creates a hold, nothing increments tripsCompleted, and nothing transitions held to ready; only the seed and the release splice touch DB.escrowHolds
Cash-debt repayment is all-or-nothing and self-attested: no amount input, no reference, no payment method, and the audit entry passes empty objects for before and after so the diff shows nothing
confirmProcessAll iterates Object.keys(DB.payouts) rather than the pending>0 subset the preview used, so driversProcessed and the audit summary overstate the batch
Escrow seed amounts embed a flat 20% take rate (paid x 0.80) contradicting DB.plans.biweekly.eyvarPct 18 and DB.plans.monthly.eyvarPct 15 for the very plans they belong to
The escrow progress bar has no zero-guard - tripsRequired of 0 emits style width NaN%
The earnings statement itemises the driver's entire trip array rather than the payout cycle it sits above, with no totals row, so the two figures can never be reconciled
deductionNote is a single overwritten slot rather than a list, so a second deduction in a cycle hides the first from the payout row and the payment confirmation modal
renderCashReconciliation is not in the boot list, so the four cash KPIs, the tolerance label, the cash queue and the debt ledger stay at a dash until the page is first opened
No partial amounts anywhere - payout, escrow release, deduction and debt repayment are all all-or-nothing, and none of the six modals contains an input
No reversal path exists for an applied or waived deduction, or for an escalated cash entry - all three are terminal states
Escrow release destroys the hold with splice rather than archiving it, so escrow history is unrecoverable after release
The release-escrow confirmation banner unconditionally asserts 'All {tripsRequired} trips completed successfully', using tripsRequired instead of tripsCompleted
#escrow-count renders DB.escrowHolds.length across all statuses in the same amber used for held, so it reads as a held count but is a total count
The payouts table gives every non-gold driver a b-silver rating chip, contradicting the Level column beside it which correctly renders b-grey for standard and new
The payouts table has no empty state - an empty DB.payouts renders headers with no rows and no message, unlike the four other lists on the page
The #cash-escalated-kpi sub-line reads 'repeat pattern detected' but the metric counts every escalation, which is an operator choice independent of driverCashRiskCount
No filter, search, sort or date range on any of the five lists, and the cash queue silently caps at 150 rows instead of paginating
Tips are simulated and displayed on the driver profile but never added to any payout balance
No deduction creation UI or generator exists - DB.deductions is seed-only with free-text types and no fee schedule
confirmPayDriver builds a rows array that is never read, and processAllPayouts accepts a btn parameter it never references
The 'final authoritative versions, override any stale duplicates' comment has nothing to override - no earlier definitions of these functions exist
Seeded audit entries contradict the seed data: AUD-0005 reports 8,200.00 SAR against a 2,360.00 total and AUD-0004 references escrow hold ESC-1035, which does not exist
UNVERIFIED: the whole cash subsystem is randomly generated from the trip-completion simulation and DB.cashLedger starts empty, so every cash figure is zero until that simulation runs
UNVERIFIED: the intended semantics of p.earned are undocumented - releaseEscrow increments it but payDriver never decrements it
The doc's line-number index places postLedger at L19918; the function actually begins at L19917

findings.summary: The only permission gate on moving rider money is contact_users ('Call / message riders & drivers') — semantically unrelated to finance
compCheck (per-case, daily and per-rider goodwill ceilings) is bypassed entirely unless the reason label contains the literal substring 'Goodwill'
window.__compApproved is a bare global with no rider/amount/actor binding — a second approval tripped on one rider authorises the next credit to any other rider
recordRefund moves money (DB.refunds + credit note + cash.gateway credit) with no requirePerm() check at all and no direct logAction entry
A subscription cancellation books the same money twice — recordRefund posts cash out while creditRiderWallet simultaneously creates an equal wallet liability
creditRiderWallet performs no sign check; a negative 'credit' drives the balance below zero, bypassing debitRiderWallet's insufficiency guard
No rollback when postLedger rejects a posting — the wallet balance and transaction have already been written and are never reversed
Every wallet credit is expensed to expense.goodwill via a fallback chain — referral bonuses, promo redemptions, manual top-ups and cancellation refunds all inflate goodwill spend
Every wallet debit is credited to revenue.fares, so reversing a mistaken credit ('Correction — issued in error') fabricates fare revenue
window.__skipGuards globally disables every confirmation dialog including the wallet money gate
The refund idempotency key carries no time bucket, so a second genuinely-separate refund of the same amount for the same relatedId is silently suppressed forever
The wallet idempotency key includes Math.floor(nowMs()/1000) — the duplicate window is one wall-clock second
Audit 'before' is always {} for wallet moves, so the prior balance can never be reconstructed from the activity log
No page-level permission on rwallets — every operator sees every rider balance and the platform's total wallet liability
getRiderWallet materialises {balance:0,transactions:[]} on a plain read, so merely opening a rider profile permanently adds them to the wallets table
Role-key mismatch: DB.compPolicy.roles has 'Operations' but no seeded teamUser carries that role, so the Ops Manager falls through to the 50/300 default tier
commitWalletAdjust calls openProfile(riderId) unconditionally on success, navigating away from the wallets list and re-rendering a hidden page
The rider is emailed that their balance rose before the ledger posting is validated, so a rejected posting leaves the rider already notified
The reason picker passes an empty onChangeExpr, so choosing 'Goodwill / apology credit' never refreshes the #comp-preview authority panel
All wallet state is in-memory DB.* with no persistence — every balance, ledger line and idempotency key resets on reload
WTX ids are 'WTX-'+Date.now(); two writes in the same millisecond (e.g. the paired processReferral credits) collide
REF- ids derive from DB.refunds.length with unshift insertion — any removal produces a duplicate id
The debit modal's max attribute is a client-side hint only and renders the raw float (e.g. max="17.299999999999997")
wallet.transactions[].balanceAfter is written on every credit and debit and read nowhere in the file
No subs['rwallets'] key exists, so the toolbar sub-title renders as an empty string on this page
recordRefund is unreachable from p-rwallets — no button, link or handler on the page invokes it
KPI 3's sub-label 'this session' is hard-coded but the count includes seeded transactions that predate the session
Seeded DB.refunds figures do not reconcile with the seeded wallets — RDR-2087 has a 69.20 SAR refund but a 17.30 SAR wallet credit
UNVERIFIED — whether addReasonCode() sets comp on runtime-created reason codes; if undefined, compCheck's rc.comp===0 block never fires
No export, search, filter, sort or pagination on the wallets table — the whole list renders unbounded

Three counters over the same data disagree: #iv-page-count and #dash-intervene-count include SLA tickets and apply the 60-minute window, while the sidebar #sbb-dash counts every ride request plus red-scenario sub-trips with no window and no tickets
The count badge is permanently red because class b b-red is written into the markup and never reassigned, so 0 renders in alert red above a green All clear message

The documented 31-60 minute watch band is unreachable for a not-moving driver: tripScenario's 'late' branch caps at 30 minutes and the 'watch' branch that claims everything up to 90 is not in scCfg, so those trips are silently dropped
assignManually re-renders the requests page but never renderInterventionsPage, so the ownership claim the operator just took is invisible here for up to 60 seconds
The builder's own doc-comment promises requests are sorted by waiting-timer descending, but they are pushed with the constant keys 0 and 999 and r.waiting is never parsed
Watch-tier sort keys are on incompatible scales (SLA 500, requests 999, sub-trips raw minutesUntil 0-60), so every watch sub-trip outranks every watch ticket and request regardless of real urgency
The card is titled 'Live trip interventions' and justified as trip-level only, yet it renders the unmodified builder output whose first branch is SLA tickets — the archetypal queue item
A second DB.upcomingSubTrips seed guarded by ||= can never run because the array assigned earlier is already truthy, leaving four inert UST- records

No permission gate anywhere on the page — neither the router branch nor any of the three action handlers checks a permission; the first requirePerm is on commitRequestAssign, two clicks away, and showNearbyDriversMap has none at all
No data-i18n attribute exists on the page and there is no nav.interventions key, so the page stays entirely English under applyLanguage('ar')
t.unavailReason is built into the scenario banner but discarded here in favour of the terse scCfg label, so an operator sees 'Driver unavailable' without the reason
The waiting-timer text is patched every second while the surrounding row is rebuilt at most once a minute, so a row can show a live counter next to a stale status
No dismiss, snooze, claim, bulk action, filter, sort control or export — an item disappears only when the underlying record changes state elsewhere

findings.summary: The Status dropdown is a no-op — savePlan() never reads #fp3-status and status is absent from both the before snapshot and the write block, so changing a plan's status from the editor is impossible

No JS range validation on the percentage fields — #fp3-comm has only an HTML max=100 and #fp3-disc has no max at all, so an eyvarPct outside 0–100 can reach commissionRateForPlan() and a discount above 100% makes the plan total negative
save_plan, archive_plan and toggle_vehicle_active are all missing from ACTION_LABELS, so this page's three most common actions render as raw snake_case keys in the activity log
toggleVehicleActive() desyncs the checkbox on permission failure — the box flips visually before requirePerm() refuses and nothing reverts it, so the UI shows a state DB does not have
No unsaved-changes guard; Cancel is only a partial cancel because toggleVehicleActive() has already written to DB and PLAN_FEATURES has already been mutated

Feature add, remove and reorder are entirely ungated — no requirePerm(), no confirmation, no audit entry; a user without manage_plans can delete every feature point and only learns of the refusal at Save
The save diff covers only 12 fields — status, ecoActive, comfortActive and features are excluded, so the audit entry names a feature count it cannot show a diff for
numval() silently restores the previous stored value when a numeric field is blank, so the * required markers on SAR/min and SAR/km are unenforced and a cleared rate is neither an error nor a zero
gv() treats a blank field as 0 while numval() treats it as 'keep previous', so the live preview and the value actually saved disagree for an empty input
Feature HTML escaping is incomplete — only double quotes are escaped, so <, > and & pass through into the value="…" attribute of a string-concatenated row
cselPick() is wired to every status option but renderPlansFormSelects() passes no onChangeExpr, so picking a status updates only the hidden input and the visible label — nothing reacts
ecoActive / comfortActive are written and audited but no renderer or pricing function reads them; the toast copy 'riders will see it on this plan' describes behaviour that does not exist
The empty-feature-list copy says 'add at least one' but validatePlanFeatures() returns null for an empty array, so a plan saves fine with zero feature points
#tb-sub goes stale after a rename — savePlan() refreshes #plan-edit-name-display and #plan-edit-sub but not the toolbar sub-line set by loadPlanEditForm()
renderPlanFeatures() is called twice on entry — once inside loadPlanEditForm() and again by the router's plan-edit branch
The whole editor ships with the weekly plan's values baked into markup, including the fictional 'plan_id: 1' sub-line and a name of 'Weekly plan' where the data says 'Weekly'
The on-page formula box is hand-written HTML with no link to cr(); the two currently agree but nothing keeps them in sync
No permission gate on entry — openPlanEdit() has no requirePerm(), so any role can open, read and type into the whole form and is only refused at Save, Archive-commit and the vehicle toggle

findings.summary: commitUserSwitch reassigns CURRENT_USER_ID to any non-Invited team user with no requirePerm gate and no confirm dialog, reachable from the top-bar avatar (L578) - any operator can assume the Owner identity and inherit all 13 permissions
impersonate() has no requirePerm gate either - only a guardAction confirm dialog, which is UX confirmation and not authorization; any operator can view-as the Owner and commit Owner-only actions

The impersonation confirm promises 'Any action you take is recorded against your name, not theirs', but logAction stamps actorId/actorName from CURRENT_USER_ID, which during impersonation is the impersonated user - audit attribution is inverted

No delete, deactivate, suspend or revoke-access path exists for a team user anywhere in the UI - DB.teamUsers is only ever pushed to and mutated in place, so an offboarded employee keeps full access forever
'Invited' is a terminal state with live permissions - can() reads u.permissions with no status check, so a never-logged-in invitee is functionally identical to an active operator for RBAC

twoFA has no setter anywhere - the Security tab surfaces non-compliance but the panel offers no way to enrol, and commitInvite creates users without the field so every invitee is twoFA:undefined and renders as '2FA off'
The invite hint promises an email invite but commitInvite sends nothing - no sendSystemEmail call, unlike other flows in the file
Nothing ever updates lastLogin or transitions Invited to Active - not impersonate, not commitUserSwitch; the column is permanently frozen demo text

Last-Owner stranding: an Owner cannot open their own Edit modal, but a different manage_team holder can demote them, and with no delete/restore path the panel can be left with no Owner and no manage_settings holder

TEAM_ROLES (4 hardcoded strings used by the invite/edit selects) is a different list from the matrix columns, which are derived from the distinct roles actually present on team users - the two can diverge if the last holder of a role is removed

Inviting as Owner silently grants all 13 permissions including manage_team and manage_settings, because defaultPermissionsForRole returns the intersection of existing Owners' permissions and USR-1 holds everything - no extra confirmation
openUserSwitchGuardless() is an empty function body with no callers

findings.summary: The granular layer never feeds back into the broad layer - revoking wallets.process_payouts in the page matrix leaves 'process_payouts' in u.permissions, so requirePerm('process_payouts') still passes at every wallet commit

30 of the 52 granular actions have no enforcement point at all - every 'view' key plus requests.cancel, live.cancel_trip, subscriptions.settle, drivers.approve, plans.edit and settings.manage_team; only 19 requirePagePerm call sites exist, covering 8 of 22 pages
settings.view is never enforced and go('settings') has no permission check - any operator can open Settings and read every configuration value including gateways, limits and cancellation fees

Mixed-state cells are lossy: an indeterminate cell is checked=false, so the first click fires onchange with this.checked===true and GRANTS the permission to every holder of the role, silently flattening deliberate per-user overrides with no warning

togglePagePermission has no self-lockout guard at all - the granular settings.manage_team action can be revoked from your own role without objection, unlike toggleRolePermission (L10781) and saveUserPermissions (L10809)

Both matrix toggles commit instantly with no confirm dialog and no undo - one mis-click rewrites the permission state of every holder of a role at once, with only a toast; no guardAction gate is registered for either toggle

settings.manage_team is dead as an enforcement key - every team and permission mutation checks the broad requirePerm('manage_team') instead (L10529, L10486, L10688, L10779, L10802), so unticking the granular checkbox does nothing
Silent no-op when a role has no users: both toggles early-return before writing and before re-rendering, leaving the DOM checkbox flipped to a state that was never persisted

No permission ever hides or disables a control - by design the gates sit on commit functions, so every operator sees every Settings save button and learns they are blocked only from a toast after clicking

renderSidebarPerms() is called at L21075 and L21086 behind typeof guards but is never defined anywhere in the file - the sidebar is therefore never filtered by permission, and impersonation changes only what commits succeed, not what is visible
There is no role entity - no UI to create, rename or delete a role; matrix columns exist only for roles currently held by a team user, so a role with no holders silently disappears from the matrix
Stale design comment says 'The original 12 permissions' while PERMISSION_LABELS holds 13 keys
_pagePermExpanded is a bare module global with no expand-all/collapse-all and no persistence, so auditing all 22 pages takes 22 clicks and resets on reload
Doc cites the Permissions tab button at L1424; the real line is L1423 (the same off-by-one as the General and Team tab buttons)

Audit-log integrity: logAction derives the entry id from DB.auditLog.length+1 while unshifting and hard-truncating the array at 500, so ids are never stable and every entry after the 500th is issued the duplicate id AUD-0501 while older security events are silently discarded

findings.summary: 'Save search phases' writes nothing - adds and removes already commit on click; the button only appends an audit entry and toasts that a change 'applies immediately'

Both radius buttons call the same saveOpsRadiusConfig(), so pressing 'Save Quick Ride radius' also commits whatever is typed in the Subscription radius field and the auto-expand checkbox, and vice versa
The two .settings-meta footers are swapped relative to their cards: #meta-ops-radius sits in the Quick Rides card while #meta-phases sits in the Subscriptions card
removeSearchPhase logs 'Removed a search phase' with empty before/after, so the audit trail cannot say which phase was removed
addSearchPhase has no duplicate-afterSec guard and no upper bound - a second phase at 8s, a ×1000 multiplier or afterSec 99999 are all accepted
Auto-expand is all-or-nothing: when it fires the radius cap is discarded entirely (within=list), so a 'last resort' can offer a trip to an arbitrarily distant driver
The coverage-blocked callout in the new-subscription modal tells the operator to change the rule in 'Settings > Pricing > Plan visibility', but plan visibility lives on Settings > Matching & Dispatch
Search phases cannot be edited - the table renders read-only text and data-phase-id is written but never read back, so changing a phase means remove plus re-add
driverActiveSubCount matches the exact string 'Active', so a driver holding several 'Expiring' subscriptions counts as zero and is treated as a new driver when the policy is closed

isPlanVisibleForRider rejects coverage found only via auto-expand (!nearby.expandedBeyondRadius), so a rider can be shown no plans at all while the same rider's quick ride would still be matched - the radio sub-copy does not mention this

renderDispatchSettings() is misnamed and mis-scoped - it fills #dispatch-tbody inside the Reason Codes & SLA pane, and its six keys are absent from the DB.commitPolicy seed so the inputs render value="undefined" until saved once
No per-city or per-zone radius override - one global quick-ride radius and one global subscription radius apply to every city in DB.cities
No maximum-wait or give-up rule - nothing on this pane defines when a searching request stops searching
Nothing inside the pane is internationalised - all five card headings, every label, both radio descriptions, the table headers, the empty state and the confirm modal are hardcoded English
renderPlanVisibility() has no in-pane trigger and savePlanVisibility() never re-renders the radios; the DOM only matches DB because the user's own click set it
On Cancel in the disable-multi-sub modal the toggle stays on because it was pre-reverted at L8053, but no re-render occurs, so the DOM can drift if the flag changed elsewhere meanwhile
mapPos is a synthetic 0-100 grid and tickEngine is a per-second simulation loop - no real driver locations or offers exist

findings.summary: rebuildAllHistory() has no requirePerm gate — the most destructive action on the tab (it generates hundreds of records into DB.trips and DB.payments) is protected only by a confirm dialog, while saveDataWindow, which merely changes a number, checks manage_settings
The rebuild's fare model (base 4.00 / perKm 1.35 / perMin 0.42) contradicts the live rate card (economy 5.00 / 1.20 / 0.40), so every reconstructed receipt is priced under rules that never existed
Reconstructed driverEarn is hardcoded at fare*0.8 while DB.rateCard.commission.onDemand is 22, so reconstructed driver earnings are systematically 2 percentage points high

saveDataWindow does parseInt(v,10)||13, so a negative value such as -5 is truthy and is stored; windowStartMs() then returns a future timestamp and every account is classified as an orphan. The HTML min="1" is never enforced in JS and there is no upper bound

windowSplit counts trips with no dateMs as inside the window (ms===undefined||ms>=start). Seeded trips generally lack dateMs and only reconstructed ones set it, so window.inside is inflated and the orphan alert is suppressed for exactly the accounts most likely to be broken
numOf() strips the minus sign via /[^\d.]/g, so a negative stored total is read as positive and never flagged

Counter scope mismatch on the same page: the window card counts only Object.keys(DB.riders) while the scan card counts riders AND drivers, so the two 'empty inside the window' totals disagree whenever a driver is an orphan
Only two checks exist (Trips and Total paid) even though entityDerived also computes payments and subs counts that are never compared against anything

reconcileEntity is monkey-patched at load (the original kept as __origReconcileEntity, otherwise unreferenced); any code path that captured the function into a local before that line would silently get the unpatched, non-window-aware version
The 40-row cap has no 'show all', and there is no sorting — red orphan rows can sit below 39 amber expected-gap rows, reachable only via the CSV export
DB.dataWindow.rationale is presented as policy in the UI but is not editable and not versioned
history_rebuilt and edit_data_window are not in ACTION_LABELS, so neither is selectable in the Activity-log action-type filter
renderSettingsMeta()'s map has no 'integrity' or 'window' key and no meta-* element exists in this pane, so the 'Last updated by …' caption is absent

The entire rebuild pathway is a demo generator (seededRand from sin(seed)*10000, a fixed 55% window split, fabricated tolls/surge/ratings); the gate text says so explicitly — 'This is not an import from billing'
UNVERIFIED — provenanceChip() call sites were not enumerated; the function is defined for entity-profile KPIs and does not appear inside renderIntegrity() or renderWindowSettings()

findings.summary: renderOnCall() targets #oncall-body, which exists nowhere in the file, so the whole simple roster feature - saveOnCall(), onCallNameSimple() and DB.onCall - is unreachable dead code that is still invoked on every Settings open
DB.onCallSchedule.overrides is read by onCallNow but never written by any UI, function or seed, so the one-off-cover feature and the ' (cover)' suffix are permanently unreachable

The escalation tier never auto-escalates: onCallName('secondary') has zero call sites, nothing promotes a breach from primary to escalation, and an empty primary slot just produces the text '- NOBODY ON CALL -'
commitHandover has no requirePerm gate at all, in contrast to setRotaSlot's requirePerm('manage_settings') - it writes a handover record and reassigns ownership of live work items ungated

currentBlock()/currentDayKey() use the real wall clock (new Date()) while the rest of the panel is pinned to the frozen demo clock REQ_NOW_REF, so 'on call now' and the blue current-shift highlight can point at a different day than every other page

The grid's onChange expression reads this.value, which is always undefined because cselPick invokes it via new Function(); only the hidden-input fallback supplies the value, and errors are swallowed by a bare catch
setRotaSlot passes no before/after payload to logAction, so the audit row shows who now holds a slot but not who was displaced
An 'Invited', never-logged-in team user is offered as an on-call assignee and as a handover recipient with no warning
onCallNow().covered (!!user) and rotaGaps() (!assign[key]) disagree for a slot assigned to a deleted user id - it reads covered in the grid and uncovered in the head strip
timezone:'Asia/Riyadh' is decorative - no conversion is performed, currentBlock uses the viewer's local getHours()
Double confirmation on handover: guardAction wraps commitHandover, so the modal's own 'Complete handover' button raises a second confirm dialog on top of the first
renderRota() rebuilds all 42 custom selects on every single slot change, destroying an open dropdown's DOM under the click
var me in openHandover is computed and never used
Handover rows render no timestamp - rec.tsMs is stored and never displayed; fromId, toId and items[].type are likewise stored and never rendered

stab.rota has no entry in the Arabic dictionary, and there are zero data-i18n attributes inside #stab-rota - day, shift and tier labels, gap warnings, the handover modal and every toast are English-only
rotaBoot deliberately seeds a partial rota - 13 of 42 slots are left empty (69% coverage), all high severity, so the gap feature has something to show on a fresh load
No notification transport exists beyond the in-panel pushOpsNotification list - nothing actually pages the named on-call person

findings.summary: The pane description claims 'Every configuration change made in Settings' but the preview applies no entityType==='settings' filter - it shows the newest 4 entries of any kind, including driver approvals, payouts and refunds
logAction unconditionally calls renderAuditLog() on every audited action panel-wide, rebuilding this preview plus the full-page list and its three custom selects even when neither page is open

switchSettingsTab renders nothing - all settings renderers fire once in go('settings'), so any tab opened long after navigation shows stale data; this preview is the only exception because logAction keeps it fresh
No permission gate on the 'View full activity log' button, and requirePagePerm('audit-log','view') is never called anywhere despite PAGE_PERMISSIONS declaring the permission
The empty-state text says 'No actions logged yet this session' although the log is pre-seeded with 8 dated entries, and it enumerates 3 of the many action kinds
The preview drops both the machine action key and the entity-link column, so an entry with a terse summary is untraceable from here
showActorHistory is unpaginated and uncapped - a busy actor renders every one of their entries, up to the global 500, in one modal
fitSettingsNavHeight is not re-run on tab switch, so the nav's computed maxHeight goes stale when the content height changes
scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) walks the scrollable ancestor chain, which includes #p-settings itself, so switching tabs can nudge the page's own scroll position
settingsLastUpdated silently reverts a section to 'No changes recorded yet' once its audit entry ages past the 500-row cap

The doc lists stabgrp.daily_ops/money/people/comms/platform/records as dead i18n keys with no markup; in fact reorderSettingsTabs creates those six headers at runtime with the matching data-i18n, so only stabgrp.other is unreachable
The doc's nav table is off by one for the first two groups - the Workspace and Operations group labels are at L1420 and L1424 (not 1421/1425) and 'reasons' is at L1430 (not 1431)

Zero data-i18n attributes inside #stab-activity - the title, the description and the button label are English-only, and stab.activity maps to the same Arabic string as nav.audit-log so the two surfaces are indistinguishable in Arabic

findings.summary: 135 of the 161 action keys in use have no ACTION_LABELS entry, so the action-type dropdown reaches only 26 keys / 31 of 220 call sites and roughly 86% of audited activity cannot be filtered for at all
entry.action is never displayed — no column, no tooltip — so a reader cannot tell what kind of action a row was except by reading the free-text summary
The free-text search haystack covers only summary, actorName, entityId and id; entityType and action are neither searched nor displayed
Audit ids are derived from array length and collide at the cap: once DB.auditLog is pinned at 500, every subsequent entry is AUD-0501
Runtime timestamps carry a time but no date, and the 8 seeded rows use a different dated format, so the Time column mixes two formats and a runtime entry cannot be dated past a day boundary
The 500-entry cap silently destroys history with no warning, no indicator and no export prompt; settingsLastUpdated reverts to 'No changes recorded yet' when a section's entry ages out

entry.summary is interpolated into the row as raw HTML with no escaping anywhere in auditRowsHTML, auditDiffHTML or auditEntityLink, while summaries are composed from operator free text and entity names at many call sites — a stored-XSS shaped injection path into the security log itself
exportAuditLog() has no permission gate and, unlike doExport(), writes no export_data audit entry — the entire audit trail can be pulled to CSV with no record that it happened
PAGE_PERMISSIONS['audit-log'] declares a 'view' permission that is grantable in the permissions matrix, but requirePagePerm('audit-log','view') has zero call sites, so any user can read the full log
auditDiffHTML iterates Object.keys(after) only, so a field removed between before and after renders nothing — deletions are invisible in every diff

Callers that pass whole arrays or objects produce [object Object] output under strict !== comparison; saveCancellationPolicy passes a deep clone as before and the same live array as after, so every element renders as changed
The CSV export drops actorId, before and after, so the diff — the strongest evidence in the log — is unexportable, and the export always covers the full array regardless of the active filters
resolveId falls back to a rider/driver NAME substring search, making the entity link non-deterministic for short entity ids — an entityId of 'AL' links to the first rider whose name contains it
The filter dropdowns are built once and only when their csel id is absent, so a team member added at runtime never appears in the actor filter
logAction forces a full renderAuditLog() on every single write, rebuilding the whole table, pager and settings preview even when neither surface is visible
The pager renders one button per page with no windowing or ellipsis, and showActorHistory is unpaginated — up to 500 rows in a single modal
The empty-state copy says 'No actions logged yet this session' over a pre-seeded array and enumerates 3 of 161 action kinds

Several line references in the doc are off by two or four: the 500-entry cap is at L3148 (doc says 3146), the AUD- id at L3136 (doc says 3137), the forced re-render at L3149 (doc says 3147), and the exportAuditLog button at L2031 (doc says 2027)
